entries.subject: DAMIT 523: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-523.txt. Model 523, version 2013-02-11, pole (293°, 49°), period 7.8367 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive models: Model 524: pole (106°, 50°), period 7.83671 h. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 524: pole (106°, 50°), 7.83671 h, version 2013-02-11. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "26.41 km (size-calibrated model)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 52.82 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 156, DAMIT model 523 diameter 57 ± 1 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 523 fitted to 1 occultation). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
